goal: Prove opt-in Rust cuda-oxide base F16 and F32 dense projection kernels without claiming ordered, paired, cuBLAS, Q8, or route behavior.

cuda_oxide.module_form: executable-local #[cuda_module] with primitive f16 weight loads and shared reductions

covered_behavior: matmul_f16_kernel shared reduction with F16 weights widened to F32 accumulation
matmul_f32_kernel shared reduction over token and output-row grid
multi-token output layout for base projection kernels
excluded_behavior: matmul_f16_serial_kernel, ordered chunks, and paired ordered kernels
F16/F32 cuBLAS path selection and f32_to_f16 activation conversion
Q8 conversion or quantized matmul kernels
runtime graph integration, default CUDA route, and C CUDA removal

rust_owned_in_this_stage: base multi-token projection layout and primitive F16 load validation
not_claimed_in_this_stage: serial, ordered-chunks, or paired F16 kernel variants
F16 or F32 cuBLAS dispatch and activation conversion
Q8 conversion or quantized matmul kernels
runtime graph integration, default CUDA route, or C CUDA removal

b300_execution.command: CARGO_HOME=/tmp/cargo RUSTUP_HOME=/tmp/rustup PATH=/tmp/cargo/bin:$PATH LIBCLANG_PATH=/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu CUDA_HOME=/usr/local/cuda-13.2 RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=nightly-2026-04-03 CUDA_OXIDE_BACKEND=/workspace/cuda-oxide/crates/rustc-codegen-cuda/target/debug/librustc_codegen_cuda.so CUDA_OXIDE_LLC=/usr/bin/llc CUDA_OXIDE_VERBOSE=1 cargo run --manifest-path /workspace/cuda-oxide/crates/cargo-oxide/Cargo.toml -- run --features cuda-oxide-kernels --bin ds4-cuda-dense-projection-smoke
